scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: bun test worker/index.test.ts worker/auth/auth.test.ts worker/tools/todo/api.test.ts src/tools/todo/lib/board.test.ts worker/tools/calendar/api.test.ts src/tools/calendar/lib/dates.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build: bun scripts/cleanBuild.mjs && bun run typecheck && bun --preload ./scripts/bunHttpCompat.mjs ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.deploy: bun run check && bun run build && bun run wrangler deploy
